name: What types of tile are best for a bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best for a bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathroom floors, durable and water-resistant tiles are essential. Porcelain tile is a popular choice due to its low porosity, making it highly resistant to water absorption and staining. Ceramic tile is also a good option, offering a wide range of styles at a more budget-friendly price point, though it's generally less dense than porcelain. Natural stone tiles like slate or travertine provide a luxurious look but require regular sealing to prevent water damage. Slip resistance is also a key factor, so look for tiles with a textured finish or a high coefficient of friction to enhance safety in a wet environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain and ceramic tiles are excellent for bathroom floors due to their water resistance and durability. Natural stone offers luxury but requires sealing. Prioritize slip resistance for safety.
